cases.purpose: Independently decode every output pixel for terminal default.
cases.oracle: DEC VT330/VT340 Graphics Programming chapter14 (https://vt100.net/docs/vt3xx-gp/chapter14.html) defines six-bit vertical columns, RGB register percentages, repeat, carriage return and next-band controls. Solid red/blue source images have an exact scale-independent expected color for every pixel. Handwritten valid and invalid wire vectors qualify the decoder before behavior.
cases.comparison: Exact dimensions and every decoded RGB pixel; raw Sixel bytes retained. The supervisor sets and reads back a private PTY pixel size, or captures through a pipe for fallback.

import errno,fcntl,importlib.util,os,pathlib,select,struct,subprocess,sys,termios,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sixel_raster','/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/sixel-raster.py')
oracle=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
label=sys.argv[2]
settings={
 'terminal-default':(16,12,True,'sixel img.tga',16,28,(100,0,0)),
 'terminal-resized':(8,12,True,'sixel img.tga',8,14,(100,0,0)),
 'explicit-width':(16,12,True,'sixel -w 8 img.tga',8,14,(100,0,0)),
 'explicit-height':(16,12,True,'sixel -H 10 img.tga',16,10,(100,0,0)),
 'zero-pixels':(0,0,True,'sixel wide.tga',800,1,(0,0,100)),
 'pipe-fallback':(16,12,False,'sixel wide.tga',800,1,(0,0,100)),
}
xp,yp,use_pty,command,width,height,color=settings[label]
master,slave=os.openpty()
fcntl.ioctl(slave,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack('HHHH',24,80,xp,yp))
assert struct.unpack('HHHH',fcntl.ioctl(slave,termios.TIOCGWINSZ,bytes(8)))==(24,80,xp,yp)
side=subprocess.Popen([sys.argv[1],'--noprofile','--norc','-c',command],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=slave if use_pty else subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
os.close(slave)
try:
 if use_pty:
  data=bytearray();deadline=time.monotonic()+6
  while True:
   if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('Sixel output deadline exceeded')
   readable,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],.05)
   if not readable:continue
   try:chunk=os.read(master,65536)
   except OSError as e:
    if e.errno==errno.EIO:break
    raise
   if not chunk:break
   data.extend(chunk)
   if len(data)>1024*1024:raise RuntimeError('Sixel output limit exceeded')
  _,err=side.communicate(timeout=2)
  data=bytes(data)
 else:data,err=side.communicate(timeout=6)
 assert side.returncode==0,(side.returncode,err)
 assert not err,err
 pathlib.Path('output.six').write_bytes(data)
 oracle.require_uniform(data,width,height,color)
 print('%s=%dx%d raster=exact'%(label,width,height))
finally:
 os.close(master)
 if side.poll() is None:side.kill();side.wait()
